steps.clue: Build and upgrade all four staffs.
Place the upgraded staffs in their four matching pedestals.
Press the button inside a robot and throw a G-Strike onto the stone seal.
Deploy the Maxis Drone into the opened seal and defeat the Panzersoldat horde.
Shoot down the glowing plane, then kill its pilot while in Zombie Blood.
Upgrade the One Inch Punch by punching glowing Templars beneath the excavation site.
Return all four staffs to the Crazy Place and collect one hundred zombie souls.
Send the Maxis Drone into the central portal to free Samantha.
